controles.affirmation: Benefice net passe de 967 M$ a 885 M$ au T2 2026 (-8,5%), 1 690 M$ contre 1 724 M$ sur le semestre ; provision pour pertes de credit en hausse de 55 M$ due a une reprise de reserves plus faible.
controles.verbatim_source: "Net earnings decreased to $885 million from $967 million" ; tableau "Net earnings | $ 885 | $ 967 | $ 1,690 | $ 1,724" ; "Provision for credit losses increased $55 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026, primarily driven by a lower reserve release in the current year period, partially offset by a decrease in net charge-offs." (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Ratio CET1 passe de 13,5% au 31/12/2025 a 13,2% au 30/06/2026, recul attribue aux rachats d'actions et dividendes.
controles.verbatim_source: "Common equity Tier 1 capital | $ 13,900 | 13.2 % | $ 14,290 | 13.5 %" ; "The decrease in our common equity Tier 1 capital ratio compared to December 31, 2025 was primarily due to share repurchases and common and preferred dividends in the six months ended June 30, 2026, partially offset by net earnings during the same period." (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Taux de charge-off net a 5,43% au T2 2026 (-27 pb) ; ratio de couverture des provisions en recul de 10,59% a 10,09%.

(10-Q T2 2026)
